استمعتما (form VIII)
# اِسْتَمَعْتُمَا (istamaʕtumā) /is.ta.maʕ.tu.maː/: second-person dual past active of اِسْتَمَعَ (istamaʕa)
# اُسْتُمِعْتُمَا (ustumiʕtumā) /us.tu.miʕ.tu.maː/: second-person dual past passive of اِسْتَمَعَ (istamaʕa)
